title: Rearview Saint
subject: driving too fast at night
caption: Phonk with darker cinematic textures. A distorted 808 sub bass sliding between notes, the signature cowbell melody, chopped and pitched vocal samples, a filtered string swell under the second half, no live drums. A low male voice half-speaks the lines, heavily doubled and slightly distorted, with reversed ad-libs in the gaps. Dusty vinyl texture over a punchy modern low end. 150 BPM, G minor. Fast, dark, propulsive.
lyrics:
[Intro - Cowbell]

[Verse 1]
Ninety on a road built for fifty
Saint on the dash that I don't believe in
He's been facing backwards seven years
Watching where I've already been

[Hook]
Rearview saint, rearview saint
Won't you look the other way
Everything ahead of me
Is nothing I can pray about

[Verse 2]
City's just a smear of orange
Radio's a language I don't speak
Every exit's got my name on it
I take none of them

[Hook]
Rearview saint, rearview saint
Won't you look the other way
Everything ahead of me
Is nothing I can pray about

[Outro - reversed]
Look the other way
